page_title: MON 0-1 RBL | B. Monchengladbach v RB Leipzig 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Robert Schroder is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
90+5' RB Leipzig take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+4' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.

90+1' Good touch by Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for a foul. Robert Schroder had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
89' The attendance for today's match is 50122.
89' B. Monchengladbach take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Here is a change. Xaver Schlager is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
84' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Xavi Simons.
83' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Joe Scally.
79' Kouadio Kone comes off the pitch to be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Rocco Reitz.

75' 0 - 1 Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Moritz Nicolas with a precise strike which ricochets in off the left post. He makes it 0:1.
73' A crossfield pass from Timo Werner (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a throw-in.
72' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
70' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Benjamin Sesko and he is replaced by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig).
70' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) replaces Lois Openda.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) will replace Fabio Carvalho.

69' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
69' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
65' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
64' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Franck Honorat will be replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
64' Substitution. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jordan Siebatcheu walks off.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.

63' Janis Blaswich pulls off a fantastic save! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header to the top left corner of the goal, but his effort is kept out. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
62' RB Leipzig take a short corner kick.

62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee blows his whistle, RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
57' A corner kick by RB Leipzig is thwarted by the well prepared Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach).

57' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.
54' Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
53' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball forward to Benjamin Sesko, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
53' A raking crossfield pass from Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for RB Leipzig.
50' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
48' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

47' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and the score remained the same.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Robert Schroder blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' None of the RB Leipzig players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

44' A sweet pass finds Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Moritz Nicolas is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. RB Leipzig have a corner.
41' A quickly taken corner by RB Leipzig.
41' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
40' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
39' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough foul. Robert Schroder stops the game and makes a call. RB Leipzig win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
31' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is caught offside!
24' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sees a yellow card from Robert Schroder after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
22' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' The linesman signals that Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
16' Robert Schroder has a clear sight and sees a foul from Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach). RB Leipzig are awarded the free kick.
14' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
11' The ball goes out for a corner. B. Monchengladbach can continue in their attacking effort.
9' Flag up against Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
7' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

6' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.
3' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.
1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes it short.

1' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
